fields.statement: A road leaves a mark long after the traffic has gone. I spent three weeks beside the salt flats, photographing the ground at the beginning and end of each day.
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

fields.statement: The crossing lasts a night. The ship holds its own hours: a corridor lit at three, a window turning grey, the shore arriving while most people sleep.
fields.cover_alt: The terminal after the last announcement
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

fields.statement: Between the thaw and the first leaves, the ground is briefly exposed. I returned to the same small area of forest over six weeks, keeping to the paths used by the people who live there.
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

fields.statement: These photographs were made within walking distance of the studio. The harbour changes by shift, tide and season; the structures remain, and the light gives them a different use.
fields.cover_alt: The crane before the morning shift
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

fields.statement: Rooms lent for an afternoon. I photographed them without moving what was there, using the light that reached each room and leaving when it went.
fields.cover_alt: A chair beside the north window
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

fields.statement: The days shortened while I was in Abisko. These photographs follow the remaining light along the road, the lake and the low slopes above the village.
fields.edition_note: Selected photographs available as signed prints in editions of ten.

/privacy.title: Privacy

seo.description: How enquiries and browser preferences are handled.

/privacy.content:
This is a demonstration privacy notice. Replace it with the workspace’s own notice before publishing.

The contact form asks for your name, email, subject, message and consent so the studio can reply. State how long enquiries are kept and how someone can request their deletion. The privacy notice remembers dismissal in local storage. Body and mono fonts are requested from Google; describe that request and any other services you add.
